description.p: roughdraft is a desktop editor for diagrams that look hand-drawn. It opens and saves Excalidraw files (.excalidraw), keeps everything in them intact, and draws them the way Excalidraw does.

ul.li: Rectangles, diamonds, ellipses, arrows, lines, freehand drawing, text, frames and images
Excalidraw's keyboard shortcuts
Copy and paste shapes to and from excalidraw.com
Export to SVG
Light and dark mode

description.p: It works offline: your drawings stay as plain files on your computer.

ul.li: Rendered web pages show the drawing's title once, and the download link matches the theme button
Arrows no longer break into stray triangles or vanish on GPU rendering when a frame sits just outside the view
Rendered web pages have a light/dark switch that remembers the reader's choice; --dark starts a page dark
Render a diagram as an SVG or as one self-contained web page, besides PNG: the format follows the output file's extension
Exported SVG files embed their fonts, so browsers show the hand-drawn text instead of a serif stand-in
roughdraft --version prints the version
Commands for scripts and coding agents: build a complete diagram from a short skeleton, check a diagram for problems, and render it to PNG without a window
An agent skill that teaches Claude Code, pi and other coding agents to draw diagrams with these commands
Arrow labels leave a gap in their arrow, as in Excalidraw
The points of a selected line or arrow highlight under the pointer
Text in the Normal font (Nunito) is measured at its own weight
Pen tool for freehand drawing, with two finer widths than Excalidraw's
A grid that drawing, moving and resizing snap to (Ctrl+')
Color picker: Excalidraw's palette in all its shades, and a hue ring for any other color
Dragging the opacity slider is one undo step
